description.value: Moku Famous Hawaiian Bbq is a Hawaiian-style barbecue restaurant located in the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region of British Columbia. The name 'Moku' references the Hawaiian concept of an island district, suggesting a menu rooted in the smoky, sweet flavours of Hawaiian plate-lunch and BBQ tradition. It is a compact stop for touring cyclists seeking a hearty, flavourful meal after a long ride through the Fraser Valley corridor.
